questions.question: What does this print?
questions.explanation: Both values are strings (text), so + joins them: "2" + "3" = "23".

questions.question: The user types 20. What type is `age`?
questions.explanation: input() always returns a string. Convert it with int(age) before doing maths.

questions.question: What does `int(3.9)` give?
questions.explanation: int() cuts off the decimal part; it doesn't round. Use round(3.9) to get 4.
